One CloudFormation / CDK stack per target
Stack name pattern: AgentCore--

div.div:
Inside the stack, AgentCoreStack receives:
- spec
- optional MCP/gateway config
- optional credential ARNs
- optional harness config
- optional payment config
- env + tags

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(245, 133, 52), rgb(189, 92, 23));

div.div:
That stack can then create the resources described by spec:
- AgentCore runtime
- Gateway
- credentials
- harnesses
- knowledge-base related resources
- payment resources
- related IAM/tagged resources

div.div:
What agentcore deploy really means here:
read local JSON config
=> build CDK app
=> synthesize stack(s)
=> deploy to each configured target
